data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add Category 8 'Operational Atomicity / Artifact-Reference Desync' to the red-team-reviewer story_review taxonomy and add operational_atomicity to the taxonomy_category enum; the pass reads the antipattern registry at registry.antipattern_path (injected via dispatch arguments), emits a registry-backed authoritative finding whose AC names the paired referencing file and requires atomic same-commit update, injects a pre-emptive audit task from a matching file_class audit_task_template, and degrades gracefully when the registry is absent or unparseable. When a registered referencing file is not co-updatable in the same commit, the finding instead emits a deferred-coordination note recorded as a story consideration.
**Why**: This is the consumption point that turns the discovered registry into planning-time findings that prevent the desync.
**Scope**:
- IN: Category 8 taxonomy + enum value; registry read at registry.antipattern_path injected via dispatch arguments with absent and unparseable diagnostics; registry-backed finding naming the paired referencing file; audit-task injection from audit_task_template; Cat 8 suppresses parallel Cat 6 for the same pair; rename/remove cases defer to Cat 7; SC6 non-co-updatable classification (git check-ignore, is_generated_file(), cross-repo URL, branch-protection) emitting a deferred-coordination consideration and follow-up task.
- OUT: the LLM-inference pass and its config gate (draft-6).

## Done Definitions

- A preplanning run over a fixture story editing a registered writer emits a finding with taxonomy_category operational_atomicity and an AC string naming the paired referencing file ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The Category 8 pass receives the registry path from the orchestrator dispatch arguments at registry.antipattern_path and does not self-discover or hardcode the path; a dispatch with no registry argument produces the registry-absent diagnostic rather than a fallback file lookup ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The red-team-reviewer.md taxonomy_category enum includes the value operational_atomicity ← Validates Closure Check: "red-team-reviewer.md taxonomy_category enum includes the value operational_atomicity."
- A Category 8 finding suppresses a parallel Category 6 finding for the same writer/reference pair; rename or remove cases defer to Category 7 ← Satisfies: sc-1
- With the registry absent the pass completes and logs registry absent; with a corrupt fixture the pass completes and logs registry unreadable as a distinct message; with a valid fixture a matching file_class injects the audit task from audit_task_template ← Satisfies: sc-5
- A generated-file fixture yields a deferred-coordination consideration and a follow-up coordination task rather than a hard atomic-update AC ← Satisfies: sc-6
- Unit tests written and passing for the registry-read diagnostics, the dispatch-arg injection path, the operational_atomicity finding emission, the Cat 6 suppression, and the SC6 non-co-updatable classification ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Dependency] The SC5 registry schema may be shipped by clear-fairy (7575-5a90); if it is not yet available, a local fixture registry supplies the {file_class, pattern, audit_task_template} + schema_version shape. Do not own migration code for clear-fairy's final schema; adaptation is limited to updating registry.antipattern_path and schema_version.
- [Build] New .sh files set the executable bit (chmod +x) on creation.
- [Correctness] The registry is injected via orchestrator dispatch arguments at registry.antipattern_path, not discovered by the reviewer itself.
- [Risk] Branch-protection lookups via gh api treat a 404 as not-protected and cache the result per-branch to avoid repeated API calls.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a story-map reviewer, I want a Category 8 atomicity pass that reads the registry and emits co-update findings with deferred-coordination handling, so that artifact-reference desync is caught before implementation.
